preamble.detail: Welcome to the PilotFish demo: EDI 837P to QCare. Directory-poll X12 837P professional claims, parse with PilotFish EDI TableData (837-Q1), and map each ST to QCare’s 2100-byte outpatient (OT / B837) flat-file record. PilotFish supports the whole flow out of the box.
